units.source_text: 过了一阵，他们从茶馆里走了出来，

en.t: After a while, they came out of the teahouse,

units.source_text: 临走之前，那个耳朵上夹着一根香烟的工人，（当然，如今耳朵上已经没有香烟了。）

en.t: and just before leaving, the worker who had had a cigarette tucked behind his ear (of course, by now the cigarette was gone)

units.source_text: 送给良平一包以报纸包裹的粗点心。

en.t: gave Ryohei a packet of plain sweets wrapped in newspaper.

units.source_text: 良平语气冷冷的回了一句：“谢谢。”
可是他立马察觉到自己的这种冷淡语气，对那位工人来说不公平。

en.t: But he immediately realized that this cold tone of his was unfair to the worker.

units.source_text: 像是为了掩饰自己冷淡的态度，良平抓起一块粗点心塞进嘴里。

en.t: As if to cover up his cold attitude, Ryohei grabbed one of the coarse sweets and stuffed it into his mouth.

units.source_text: 可能是用报纸包裹的原因吧，点心上散发着一股油墨味。

en.t: Perhaps because they had been wrapped in newspaper, the sweets gave off a smell of printing ink.
